description: datetime extension type: construction, normalization, comparison, and methods

tests.name: date_only_eq_midnight
tests.description: date-only form equals explicit UTC midnight
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-10-15") == datetime("2024-10-15T00:00:00.000Z") };

tests.name: trailing_t_without_time_rejected
tests.description: a bare trailing T without a time component errors
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-08-21T") == datetime("2024-08-21T00:00:00.000Z") };

tests.name: positive_offset_normalization
tests.description: +0100 offset normalizes to one hour earlier in UTC
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-10-15T11:35:00+0100") == datetime("2024-10-15T10:35:00Z") };

tests.name: negative_offset_normalization
tests.description: -0500 offset normalizes to five hours later in UTC
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-10-15T11:35:00-0500") == datetime("2024-10-15T16:35:00Z") };

tests.name: fractional_ms_greater_than
tests.description: millisecond precision is preserved and ordered
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-10-15T11:35:00.123Z") > datetime("2024-10-15T11:35:00.000Z") };

tests.name: less_than_dates
tests.description: earlier date is less than later date
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-10-15") < datetime("2024-10-16") };

tests.name: greater_or_equal_when_equal
tests.description: >= holds for equal datetimes
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-10-15") >= datetime("2024-10-15") };

tests.name: before_unix_epoch_ordering
tests.description: dates before 1970 produce negative epoch ms ordered correctly
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("1969-12-31") < datetime("1970-01-01") };

tests.name: leap_day_valid
tests.description: 2024-02-29 is a valid date in a leap year
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-02-29") < datetime("2024-03-01") };

tests.name: duration_since_positive
tests.description: durationSince returns the elapsed duration
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-10-15T01:00:00Z").durationSince(datetime("2024-10-15")) == duration("1h") };

tests.name: duration_since_negative
tests.description: durationSince is negative when the receiver precedes the argument
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-10-14T23:18:00Z").durationSince(datetime("2024-10-15")) == duration("-42m") };

tests.name: duration_since_cross_day_offset
tests.description: durationSince across a day boundary with a timezone offset
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-10-16T00:00:00-0500").durationSince(datetime("2024-10-15")) == duration("1d5h") };

tests.name: offset_positive
tests.description: offset shifts a datetime forward by a duration
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-10-15").offset(duration("1d")) == datetime("2024-10-16") };

tests.name: offset_negative
tests.description: offset shifts a datetime backward by a negative duration
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-10-15").offset(duration("-1d")) == datetime("2024-10-14") };

tests.name: to_date_truncates
tests.description: toDate truncates the time portion to 00:00:00 UTC
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-10-15T11:35:00Z").toDate() == datetime("2024-10-15") };

tests.name: to_time_utc
tests.description: toTime returns milliseconds since the start of the UTC day
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2025-02-20T10:35:00Z").toTime() == duration("10h35m") };

tests.name: to_time_with_offset
tests.description: toTime reflects the UTC-normalized time of day
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2025-02-20T10:35:00-0500").toTime() == duration("15h35m") };

tests.name: context_datetime_attr_comparison
tests.description: datetime injected via context compares against a literal
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { context.now > datetime("2024-01-01") };

tests.name: principal_datetime_attr_expiry
tests.description: expiry-style policy using a principal datetime attribute
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { principal.hireDate.offset(duration("365d")) < datetime("2025-01-01") };

tests.name: different_extension_types_not_equal
tests.description: datetime and duration compared with == are unequal (distinct types)
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("1970-01-01") == duration("0s") };

tests.name: malformed_non_leap_feb29
tests.description: 2025-02-29 is not a valid date; constructor errors
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2025-02-29") == datetime("2025-03-01") };

tests.name: malformed_bad_month
tests.description: month 13 is invalid; constructor errors
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-13-01") == datetime("2024-13-01") };

tests.name: malformed_time_without_timezone
tests.description: a time component requires a timezone designator
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-10-15T11:35:00") == datetime("2024-10-15T11:35:00Z") };

tests.name: malformed_colon_offset
tests.description: offset must be +/-hhmm, not +/-hh:mm
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { datetime("2024-10-15T11:35:00+01:00") == datetime("2024-10-15T10:35:00Z") };

tests.name: context_datetime_attr_malformed_errors
tests.description: injecting a malformed datetime context attribute is an error
tests.policy: permit (principal, action, resource) when { context.now == datetime("2024-01-01") };
